title: 2-Day Grand Canyon, Antelope Canyon, Monument Valley and Sedona
includes: Meals except lunch on the first day (not included)
Additional National Park Entrance Fee (Non-U.S. Residents Only) USD 100.00 per person (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children over 3 years old can participate.
If the participants include toddlers, please be sure to bring a front chest carrier or a backpack carrier.
policies: Pick-up time and details of meeting place will be informed after your booking is confirmed.

The size of luggage that can be brought into the vehicle is limited to one piece per person and must be small enough to be held on your lap; any luggage that requires dedicated storage space will be subject to an additional fee.
Only one lunch on the first day is included in the tour price. All other meals will be at the customer's actual expense.
The itinerary may change depending on weather and congestion on the day.
You may not see the sunrise due to weather or other reasons and poor visibility may prevent you from enjoying the scenery.
No backpacks, shoulder bags, or other bags are allowed in Antelope Canyon. Selfie sticks, tripods, monopods, GoPro etc. are also prohibited. You may leave all but your valuables in your vehicle.
Antelope Canyon may be closed due to weather like rain/snow. Partial refunds will be made if there is no alternative sightseeing spot.
Please wear comfortable walking shoes such as sneakers or hiking shoes. Sandals and heels are not suitable.
Changes in the date or number of people on the tour will also be subject to the cancellation policy.
The order of the tour itinerary may be reversed during peak season or due to weather conditions.
Please Note: National Park fees may apply for international visitors. If applicable, this fee is collected in-destination and not at the time of booking.
Dual-language guiding (English and Japanese) may be provided depending on the participants.
cancellation:
If you cancel at least 3 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.
If you cancel within 3 day(s) of the scheduled departure, you will receive a 0% refund.
blurb: Experience the best of the Grand Circle in just 2 days and 1 night! Visit iconic sights like Horseshoe Bend, Lower Antelope Canyon (or Antelope Canyon X), Forrest Gump Point, Monument Valley, and the Grand Canyon's South Rim, plus the stunning landscapes of Sedona, Lake Powell, and Seligman on Route 66. This action-packed tour combines breathtaking natural wonders and historic landmarks, offering a truly unforgettable adventure.
